svg.title: Key person dependencies in the bid process
svg.text: Who the process actually depends on
Roughly a dozen people run this entire process. Six of them are difficult to replace at short notice.

g.text: Ray Scott — Director of IT
The automated feed that loads every product and price from Vista signs in using his personal account,
with a password set in October 2020. If that account is disabled or the password is changed, the feed
stops — and nothing alerts anyone. This has already happened once, in August 2025.
Alex Collins
First approver on almost every rule —
11 of them. If he is away, quotes queue
at the first step.
Lou Mangiaracina
The escalation path — 6 rules, mostly
second and third step. Together with Alex,
96% of all approvals.
Mary Irizarry
Generates about half of the 305 customer
proposals produced every month, by hand.
Your outside consultant
Makes 100% of configuration changes to
the quoting system. Nobody internal does.
Mark Evans + around 7 sales people
Account and tax upkeep, and the open bid pipeline. Spread across enough people to absorb an absence.

svg.text: The upside of a small team
Any change here reaches about a dozen people. That is a pilot, not a company-wide rollout programme.
